lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-torso region, with decreasing intervals and increased fragmentation observed toward the posterior quadrant.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation point observed at the ventral terminus of the 7th and 8th vertical lines from the anterior, where segments converge into a single terminal point.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines 1, 9, 10, and 11 exhibit significant vertical discontinuities, transitioning into a series of isolated circular blobs in the ventral third of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, characterized by a non-uniform distribution with higher density on the posterior edge of the limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of 3 distinct white spots forming a semi-linear geometric pattern across the mid-thigh of the trailing hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent white spots located on the facial cheek area below the eye and white transverse bands visible on the distal segments of all visible limbs.
